description: eas device:create with the Input method: registers one UDID (any Apple device class, including a watch the Developer Portal import leaves out) under the project's Expo account. Needs EXPO_TOKEN in the caller's environment: the eas zsh wrapper is bypassed by npx.

hints.text: npx is starting eas-cli. If it stalls on a login, EXPO_TOKEN is missing
Apple's developer API lists every registered device, it is often slow

on.prompt: Would you like to use the .* account\?
^Do you want to log in to your Apple account\?
^How would you like to register your devices\?
^Is this what you want to register\?
^Do you want to register another device\?
